title: Ordinary evaluation of the transported open-system counit
statement: For an open immersion j, normalized integral open operations o, coefficient level n and an ordinary strict system N on X, let rho:evaluation_n(systemRestriction N)≅finiteRestriction_n(evaluation_n N) be the explicit comparison composed from the finite equivalence unit, inverse transportEvaluation, the system equivalence counit and openSystems.restrictionEvaluation. Then finiteExtension_n(rho) followed by the finite composite-adjunction counit equals inverse extensionEvaluation at systemRestriction N followed by evaluation_n of the ordinary system-adjunction counit.

source.place: Scalar-extension adjunction and ordinary open extension (Tags 03CZ and 03DJ), with sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YY and 0941; ordinary and augmentation steps of lem-sf-open-restriction-counit-on-good-complexes.

proof.text: For an equivalence e and z:e.functor(M)→N, naturality of the counit and the triangle identity give e.functor(unit_M followed by e.inverse(z)) followed by counit_N = z.

Expand the finite composite counit and combine inverse transport, the system equivalence counit, and restriction evaluation into z. Apply the preceding identity and the counit_evaluation field of openSystems.
Use inverse extension-evaluation naturality at the system-equivalence counit. Expand the actual extension evaluation and composite system counit; associativity identifies the resulting words.

proof_origin.place: B8: explicit ordinary-system assembly, scalar-unit naturality and equivalence counit algebra for the existing restriction-counit argument.

mathlib_searches.query: Localization of an exact adjunction counit on chain complexes; counit naturality and adjunction mate compatibility
mathlib_searches.results: Found localization_counit_app and derived counit APIs. They provide formal localization but no coefficient-presentation statement.
Found both standard categorical identities; used in the proof. No strict quotient-presentation assembly theorem.

Existing semilinear system isomorphism assembly supplies an ordinary model for the construction; scalar-unit augmented naturality and transported coefficient counit require the explicit calculations here.

from.place: The ordinary counit and strict augmentation calculation in proof steps 1–3.

lean.statement:
theorem openSystemCounitEvaluation (n : ℕ) (N : coefficientSequenceModules l E X) :
    (finiteExtension l E j o n).map (counitRestrictionEvaluation l E j o n N).hom ≫
      ((o.finite n).toAdjunction.comp
        (SheafOfModules.localizedSystemAdjunction.{t+1, t, max u (t + 1)}
          (rings l E X n) (openObject j))).counit.app
            ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).obj N) =
    (extensionEvaluation l E j o n).inv.app ((systemRestriction l E j o).obj N) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).map
        ((ordinarySystemAdjunction l E j o).counit.app N)
